# toolbar-navigation

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-001 — The toolbar groups its controls, collapses and remembers view choices](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-001.md) — When a reader opens a preview, the Studio SHALL show its controls in five clearly grouped rows that never overlap each other, let the reader collapse them to the first row, and keep the view choices for the workspace, in read-only previews too.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-002 — The reader folds and unfolds the sections of the document](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-002.md) — The preview SHALL let the reader fold a section of the document under its heading and unfold it again, one section at a time or all at once, without changing the document.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-003 — The reader finds and replaces text in the preview](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-003.md) — The preview SHALL let the reader find text in the rendered page and replace it in the document, without leaving the preview.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-004 — The reader always sees the section being read](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-004.md) — When a reader scrolls a document, the Studio SHALL keep the current heading and its parent headings pinned at the top of the preview without moving the text, as many levels as the reader set, between one and six.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-006 — The reader uses a table of contents beside the document](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-006.md) — When a reader presses the Table of contents button, the Studio SHALL show or hide a column that lists the document's headings, mark the section being read, let the reader fold sections and jump to a heading, and keep the text, the tables and the pinned headings clear of the column.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-009 — The reader goes Back and Next through followed links without losing typed text](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-009.md) — When a reader follows links and anchors in the preview, the Studio SHALL let the reader return with Back and Next to the document and line they left, saving what was typed in an open block or properties editor before it navigates.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-011 — Links open the right target, show where they lead, or are refused with a reason](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-011.md) — When a reader clicks a link in the preview, the Studio SHALL open its target, or refuse it with a reason, show in the tooltip of a link that comes into view the file it leads to or the reason it cannot be followed, and never open a file outside the workspace unless the reader enabled the frontmatter outside-link setting.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-013 — The reader decides how the panes scroll together and sees the cursor block](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-TOOLBAR-013.md) — When a reader presses the Anchor button, the Studio SHALL switch, for that preview panel, whether the preview and the text editor scroll together, and when the reader turns on the setting that marks the editor selection, outline in the preview the block that matches the text editor's cursor line.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
